outcome: Expose pinned native skills and qualify actual repository task evidence without mistaking discovery, partial runs, or infrastructure failures for accepted delivery.
constraints: Do not edit generated files or old releases
No global agent configuration changes, game changes or remote publishing
Model calls remain opt-in and bounded; raw traces stay untracked
Native support, task execution, repository DoD and human acceptance are distinct

acceptance.description: Native skills are composed from one pinned source and drift is detected
Incomplete, truncated or self-asserted evidence cannot satisfy the scorer
Task and repository delivery qualification are distinct
Agent attempts retain versions, traces, blocked cases and independent checks

tier_waivers.reason: Live provider trials are separately recorded observations, not CI tests or a fully qualified cross-agent product E2E. Provider/network blocks and projected evidence gaps remain explicit.
